When Anthropic and OpenAI gave Zscaler access to their Frontier AI models, we didn't just study the

## The Zscaler Platform

The cybersecurity platform for the AI Age - built on Zero Trust to protect users, workloads,
branches and devices through the world’s largest inline security cloud.

Secure data everywhere, with comprehensive visibility and controls across all channels.

##### AI Security

Embrace AI with confidence using Zscaler AI Protect, a unified solution to secure AI at scale.

##### Agentic SecOps

Draw on insights from the world’s largest inline security cloud and third-party sources to assess
risk and detect and contain breaches.

[Learn more][192]

## ThreatLabz 2026 Phishing and Initial Access Report

Phishing is getting quieter and more dangerous. Although volume is down ~20% YoY, AI is accelerating
targeted lures and initial access.

 

Zscaler ThreatLabz uncovered how attackers are now moving beyond the inbox; by probing exposed
attack surfaces, validating stolen credentials, and executing account takeover inside encrypted
traffic.

# Zero-Trust Secure Connectivity for Critical Infrastructure and Industrial Control Systems

Agilicus enables any user, on any device, secure connectivity to any resource they need—without a
client or VPN. Whether that resource is a web application, a programmable logic control, or a
building management system, Agilicus can secure it with multi-factor authentication while keeping
the user experience simple with single sign-on.

[CONTACT ME][30]
[BOOK MEETING][31]
[TRY NOW][32]

## Simple, Secure Connectivity

Single sign-on for any user—first party, third party, joint venture, contractor, or vendor. Enforce
multi-factor authentication everywhere.

Fine-grained access control and audit on a per-resource basis. No broad-access VPN risks. No
end-user software to install.

The effectiveness of an air gap with the simplicity of the Internet. No inbound IP or connectivity
needed.

Any resource: PLC, Building Management System, Database, Share, Desktop. No integration required.

[federated-identity]

**Federate Identity** across your workforce, enable single sign-on, and use Zero Trust to authorize,
authenticate, and enable access.

[User-Management-Controls]

**Simplify onboarding** without having to modify your active directory, add licenses, or issue
corporate devices.

[role-based-access-controls]

**Pair users** with the resources they need using **centralized user and role management**.

[secure-access]

**Easily** enforce **multi-factor authentication** policies and enable or disable **access
privileges**.

## Legacy Network Solutions Are Holding You Back

People are working and connecting from anywhere. That means traditional and legacy perimeter-based
approaches to secure access and network security just don’t cut it anymore. Here’s why:

[vpn-high-fixed-costs]

#### High Fixed Costs

VPNs have a lot of overhead and require significant time and resources to maintain, secure, and
manage placing undue burden on your IT teams.

[vpn-cyber-risk]

#### They Put Your Organisation at Risk

Hackers target VPNs and public gateways. They expose your organisation to risks like lateral network
traversal and ransomware.

[vpn-antiquated-technology]

#### Antiquated Technology

VPN technology is over 25 years old and no longer serves your business. Security measures are front
and center, hindering employee experience.

## Agilicus Can Help

Agilicus introduces a cloud-native Zero Trust Network Access platform that removes the complexity of
extending secure access to employees and non-employees. With federated identity and single sign-on,
you can maintain your native active directory and identity providers allowing users to easily
self-onboard.

Spanning the gamut from simple web applications to complex critical-infrastructure industrial
control system components like an HMI, a PLC, SCADA, a Building Management System BMS, we handle it
all.

[no-end-user-clients]

#### No End-User Clients

[no-vpn]

#### No VPNs

[no-gateways]

#### No Gateways or Appliances

[no-new-passwords]

#### No New User ID’s or Passwords

## Zero Trust at Your Own Pace – Integrate with Your Native Identity Provider

[identity-aware-firewall]

### [Identity Aware Web Application Firewall][33]

[secure-remote-desktop-access]

### [Remote Desktop Access Through Zero Trust][34]

[secure-remote-access-any-device]

### [Secure Access to Any Application or Database][35]

[secure-file-sharing]

### [Secure Access to Shares][36]

The Agilicus platform provides a simple means of federating any identity provider, public or
private. Enable single sign-on and use your Azure Active Directory in unison with a partner company
or integrate with your native identity provider (Google, Apple, Okta, Microsoft). This provides the
most natural sign-in experience for the end-users where security can be enriched with multi-factor
authentication – all without the need for new passwords or user ids.

With Agilicus you can quickly and easily segment users and manage their privileges to web
applications, remote desktops, shares, applications, and databases whether they are on-premise,
working remotely, or external to your organisation.

Enable simple, secure access for any user, on any device, anywhere

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &

#### Who we are

# At ControlSoft Canada, we provide custom solutions to our clients Automation hardware and software
# needs.

Our Team of hardware and software engineers have expertise in finding solutions for new and existing
legacy automation system upgrades. We share and provide our deep knowledge in electrical controls
design, automation controls software and SCADA systems.

ControlSoft Canada provides full system development life cycle including control panel upgrades,
modernization with the latest PLC design and software, system integration, and support for MES
integration, along with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) solutions including PLC
control system design and programming for manufacturing plants and industrial facilities.

ControlSoft Canada have demonstrated expertise over the last 15 years with successful implementation
using following software and design tools.

  Our advisory cyber security consulting services offer a clear cybersecurity strategy and counsel

  Our Cybersecurity Program & Vulnerability Consulting Service brings many of the world’s top
  security professionals together to protect your business.

  CyberSecOp’s Security Operations Center (SOC) as a Service provides unparalleled cyber security
  coverage that monitors, detects, and responds to threats so you can rest assured that your
  information is safe. We implement and support IT security solutions such as SIEM, MDR, DLP, CASB,
  AEP, XDR, and Zero Trust.
  
  [ LEARN MORE ][197]

  Regulatory Compliance Readiness consulting services: Comprehensive support throughout rigorous
  regulatory requirements.

# Responsible Artificial Intelligence and Strategic Risk Management

## A VISION TO PROTECT AND SECURE THE WORLD

Securing The AI Future

Through Trusted Partnerships

[DEW Diligence, LLC][7] delivers Responsible AI governance and risk-based Information Security
consulting — helping leaders turn digital transformation risk into clear, executive decisions. We
align security strategy to business goals and help you implement what matters most to reduce
exposure, strengthen resilience, and support compliant growth.

[DEW Diligence LLC enterprise servers]

## OUR SOLUTIONS

Strategic Solutions, Technology, and Risk Services

### INFORMATION SECURITY CONSULTING

Strategic Solutions 

Risk Management

IBM Institute for Business Value ([IBV][8]) reports 96% of leaders believe gen AI increases breach
likelihood — while only 24% of current gen AI projects are secured.


[DEW Diligence][9] helps organizations close that gap with a practical, risk-based approach —
aligning data protection, AI governance, and cybersecurity controls to business outcomes. We guide
leaders through cyber risk treatment decisions and deliver the right mix of advisory, technology,
and implementation. As your trusted security advisor, we simplify enterprise solution selection and
help you operationalize security end-to-end.

[Services ][10]
[DEW Diligence LLC computer monitors]
[DEW Diligence LLC code and glasses]

### RESPONSIBLE AI GOVERNANCE

AI Governance

AI Security

AI Governance
Structure, policy, and accountability for AI that holds up under scrutiny.

 

Most organizations have AI in production before governance catches up. DEW Diligence builds the
operating model behind it, risk tiering, accountability structures, policy, and the controls that
hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

 

AI Security
Protection for AI systems, models, and the data that powers them.


AI expands your attack surface in ways most security programs haven't mapped yet. We close that gap,
from model risk and adversarial threats to third-party AI supply chain exposure.

 

DEW Diligence brings both disciplines together, helping leaders deploy AI responsibly, govern it
rigorously, and answer for it confidently — your human-in-the-loop.

 

No tool does this for you. We do.

[Services ][11]

Why This Matters

[IBM’s Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025 ][12]found that, among organizations reporting an
AI-related breach, 97% lacked proper AI access controls, and 63% of breached organizations didn’t
have an AI governance policy or were still developing one.


Shadow AI breaches cost ~$700K more on average & account for 20% of all breaches. 

## THE COST OF INACTION

Costs of a Data Breach

$4.44M

2025 Global Average Per Breach

$10.22M

2025 US Average Per Breach

$10.5T

2025 Global Cybercrime Costs Projection

$3.8M

Annual Average Cost To Prevent Cybersecurity Breaches

Sources: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025; IBM X-Force Threat Intelligence Index 2026

Here’s what the numbers tell us:

 

The signal is consistent. The risk pattern is clear, and the control gap is measurable. With 63% of
breached organizations lacking sufficient AI governance, and 97% lacking adequate access controls.
AI without governance isn't a strategy. It's an open door.

 

Organizations that are effectively securing AI and using AI in security saved an average of $1.9
million per breach and reduced the breach lifecycle by 80 days. The question isn't whether you can
afford AI security and governance. 

 

The real question is whether you can afford the alternative.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Diagrams.so?

Diagrams.so is a web-based SaaS platform that transforms natural language descriptions into
professional, editable Draw.io architecture diagrams. It uses AI to generate standard .drawio XML
files with correct cloud provider icons (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes) and proper layout. In seconds,
not hours.

### What file format do diagrams export in?

All diagrams export as standard .drawio XML files (the same format used by Draw.io (diagrams.net).
These files open natively in Draw.io desktop, Draw.io web, Confluence, VS Code, Notion, and any tool
that supports the .drawio format). You can also export as PNG, PDF, JPG, and SVG.

### How is this different from Draw.io's built-in AI Generate feature?

Draw.io's native AI generates basic diagrams within their editor. Diagrams.so provides a
purpose-built experience with architecture-specific prompt optimization, a warnings engine that
catches common mistakes (single-AZ, public exposure), an Opinionated Mode that suggests missing
components, a community gallery for sharing and forking, and a web-first workflow. No menu-diving
required.

### Do I need to install anything?

No. Diagrams.so is entirely browser-based. No extensions, no API keys, no local servers, no Node.js
setup. Visit diagrams.so, describe your architecture, and download your diagram. That's it.

### Which cloud providers are supported?

AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Kubernetes icon libraries are fully supported with
official icons. We also support generic network, database, security, and general-purpose shapes for
non-cloud diagrams including mechanical engineering, workflow, and process diagrams.

### How does the credit system work?

Usage is measured in credits based on the AI tokens used. Simple diagrams cost about 1 credit,
complex ones 2–3 credits, and edits about 0.5 credits—so you can iterate without penalty. Free gets
10 credits; Pro gets 75/month with rollover; Power gets 250/month with rollover. Failed generations
do not use credits. Rate limiting may apply for fair use.

### Can I use my own LLM API key?

Yes. Pro and Power users can add their own OpenAI or Anthropic API keys in Settings. When a personal
key is configured, diagram generation does not consume your plan credits, giving you effectively
unlimited generation at your own API cost.

### Are my diagrams private?

Free tier diagrams are public by default and appear in the community gallery. Pro and Power users
can create private diagrams that are visible only to them. You can toggle any diagram between public
and private at any time.

### Is my data secure?

Yes. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Diagrams are stored in AWS
infrastructure with SOC 2-aligned security practices. We never train AI models on your diagrams or
prompts. See our Security page for full details.

### Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Both monthly and annual plans can be cancelled at any time from your account settings or Stripe
customer portal. Monthly plans end at the current billing period. Annual plans include a 14-day
money-back guarantee.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Diagrams.so?

Diagrams.so is a web-based SaaS platform that transforms natural language descriptions into
professional, editable Draw.io architecture diagrams. It uses AI to generate standard .drawio XML
files with correct cloud provider icons (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes) and proper layout. In seconds,
not hours.

### What file format do diagrams export in?

All diagrams export as standard .drawio XML files (the same format used by Draw.io (diagrams.net).
These files open natively in Draw.io desktop, Draw.io web, Confluence, VS Code, Notion, and any tool
that supports the .drawio format). You can also export as PNG, PDF, JPG, and SVG.

### How is this different from Draw.io's built-in AI Generate feature?

Draw.io's native AI generates basic diagrams within their editor. Diagrams.so provides a
purpose-built experience with architecture-specific prompt optimization, a warnings engine that
catches common mistakes (single-AZ, public exposure), an Opinionated Mode that suggests missing
components, a community gallery for sharing and forking, and a web-first workflow. No menu-diving
required.

### Do I need to install anything?

No. Diagrams.so is entirely browser-based. No extensions, no API keys, no local servers, no Node.js
setup. Visit diagrams.so, describe your architecture, and download your diagram. That's it.

### Which cloud providers are supported?

AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Kubernetes icon libraries are fully supported with
official icons. We also support generic network, database, security, and general-purpose shapes for
non-cloud diagrams including mechanical engineering, workflow, and process diagrams.

### How does the credit system work?

Usage is measured in credits based on the AI tokens used. Simple diagrams cost about 1 credit,
complex ones 2–3 credits, and edits about 0.5 credits—so you can iterate without penalty. Free gets
10 credits; Pro gets 75/month with rollover; Power gets 250/month with rollover. Failed generations
do not use credits. Rate limiting may apply for fair use.

### Can I use my own LLM API key?

Yes. Pro and Power users can add their own OpenAI or Anthropic API keys in Settings. When a personal
key is configured, diagram generation does not consume your plan credits, giving you effectively
unlimited generation at your own API cost.

### Are my diagrams private?

Free tier diagrams are public by default and appear in the community gallery. Pro and Power users
can create private diagrams that are visible only to them. You can toggle any diagram between public
and private at any time.

### Is my data secure?

Yes. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Diagrams are stored in AWS
infrastructure with SOC 2-aligned security practices. We never train AI models on your diagrams or
prompts. See our Security page for full details.

GDH is a global IT staffing and professional services firm committed to always delivering more.
Better talent. More client support. World-class workforce outcomes. Let’s get to work.

GDH helps organizations solve today’s most critical technology challenges through specialized talent
and professional services across:
* Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
* Data Engineering & Analytics
* Cybersecurity & Risk Management
* Cloud Transformation

* DevOps & Platform Engineering

care for our clients’ businesses and goals. Enthusiastic care for the career and life journeys of
our consultants and employees. Care to us is so much more than a nice idea. It’s fundamental to who

hardware-based manageability are the prerequisites that let that assumption hold, and most Windows

##### About IJARIIE

## Empowering Researchers Worldwide

IJARIIE is a leading international journal that provides a platform for researchers, academicians,
and practitioners to share their knowledge and innovative ideas. We are committed to publishing
high-quality research that contributes to the advancement of science and technology.

Our rigorous peer-review process ensures that only the best work is published, while our open-access
policy ensures that it reaches the widest possible audience. Whether you are a student, a professor,
or an industry professional, IJARIIE is the perfect place to publish your work.

### Easy Submission

dashboard for tracking.

review process.

### Quality Publication

databases.

All published papers are freely available for download and citation, increasing the visibility of
your work.

### Quantum networking

IonQ is at the forefront of quantum networking to secure communications and protect critical data
from current and future threats.

Learn more

### Quantum security

Quantum key distribution (QKD) is used to secure communications and build the foundation of a global
quantum internet.

Learn more

### Quantum sensing

Harness precise measurement capabilities for ultra high precision and accuracy. IonQ’s quantum
sensors enable revolutionary advances in navigation, medical imaging, and resource discovery.

### Quantum space infrastructure

Built for speed, accuracy, and reliability, we deliver Earth-observation infrastructure engineered
to support quantum-secure communications, protected networks, and precision data transfer,
safeguarding critical intelligence for government and allied operators requiring high-fidelity ISR.

## Industry use case highlights

[

### Quantum-accelerated drug development

In collaboration with AstraZeneca, AWS, and NVIDIA, IonQ executed the largest quantum-accelerated
electronic structure simulation performed to date. This groundbreaking approach accelerated the
complex chemistry simulation by at least 656 times.

Read more
][108][
[Enterprise-grade LLMs with quantum fine tuning]

### Enterprise-grade LLMs with quantum fine tuning

IonQ's quantum fine-tuning is a hybrid approach that adds a quantum layer to classical AI models.
This method makes LLMs smarter and more efficient by capturing higher-dimensional patterns that
classical systems miss.

Read more
][109][

### Advancing automotive materials with quantum AI

IonQ partnered with a leading global automotive manufacturer, applying quantum-classical AI to solve
critical materials science challenges. Our model successfully generated higher-fidelity synthetic
data for steel microstructures.

Read more
][110][
[Unlocking foundry-scale quantum production]

### Unlocking foundry-scale
### quantum production

IonQ is pioneering the use of quantum-grade diamond thin films, a breakthrough that allows diamond
quantum devices to be manufactured at an industrial scale. This approach leverages semiconductor
techniques, dramatically simplifying manufacturing.

Read more
][111][
[Enterprise ready quantum computer]

### Machine learning image recognition

For self driving cars to become a reality, vehicles must interface with road signs in the physical
world. In our work with Hyundai, we explored loading images of road signs into our quantum computers
for analysis. With only 8 qubits, we successfully trained a quantum machine learning image
recognition algorithm to recognize common road signs with fewer input parameters than comparable
classical approaches.

Read more
][112]
[Quantum cloud made for developers]

## A quantum cloud made for developers

Forget translating your work into yet another quantum SDK. IonQ works with all of the most popular
cloud providers, libraries and tools. Just sign in and get to work.

## Industry use case highlights

[

### Quantum-accelerated drug development

In collaboration with AstraZeneca, AWS, and NVIDIA, IonQ executed the largest quantum-accelerated
electronic structure simulation performed to date. This groundbreaking approach accelerated the
complex chemistry simulation by at least 656 times.

Read more
][108][
[Enterprise-grade LLMs with quantum fine tuning]

### Enterprise-grade LLMs with quantum fine tuning

IonQ's quantum fine-tuning is a hybrid approach that adds a quantum layer to classical AI models.
This method makes LLMs smarter and more efficient by capturing higher-dimensional patterns that
classical systems miss.

Read more
][109][

### Advancing automotive materials with quantum AI

IonQ partnered with a leading global automotive manufacturer, applying quantum-classical AI to solve
critical materials science challenges. Our model successfully generated higher-fidelity synthetic
data for steel microstructures.

Read more
][110][
[Unlocking foundry-scale quantum production]

### Unlocking foundry-scale
### quantum production

IonQ is pioneering the use of quantum-grade diamond thin films, a breakthrough that allows diamond
quantum devices to be manufactured at an industrial scale. This approach leverages semiconductor
techniques, dramatically simplifying manufacturing.

Read more
][111][
[Enterprise ready quantum computer]

### Machine learning image recognition

For self driving cars to become a reality, vehicles must interface with road signs in the physical
world. In our work with Hyundai, we explored loading images of road signs into our quantum computers
for analysis. With only 8 qubits, we successfully trained a quantum machine learning image
recognition algorithm to recognize common road signs with fewer input parameters than comparable
classical approaches.

Read more
][112]

Forget translating your work into yet another quantum SDK. IonQ works with all of the most popular
cloud providers, libraries and tools. Just sign in and get to work.

Sovereign AI agents that enrich, triage, and brief — integrated directly into operational channels.

Attribute-Based Access Controls, classification banners, burn-on-read, data spillage mitigation, to

## Purpose-built for critical infrastructure use cases:

### Self Sovereign Collaboration

#### Meet evolving data control and user needs for real-time workflows

**Challenge**: Organizations need to adapt to evolving international data control laws, user needs,
vendor roadmaps and EOL schedules.

**Mattermost Benefit: **
* Faster, better decisions and results

* Ensure long-term commitment to self-hosting
* Accelerate cross-organizational collaboration

### Integrated Security Operations

#### Increase resilience with faster detection, response, and remediation workflows

**Challenge: **Security organizations are understaffed and overhwelmed by alerts, tasks, and a
continually expanding threat landscape.

**Mattermost Benefit:**
* Streamline and simplify incident collaboration
* Accelerate efficiency
* Faster detection, response and remediation

[Learn More »][86]

### Command + Control

#### Accelerate decision advantage, resilience and real-time outcomes

**Challenge: **Expanding adversarial risk in cyber and kinetic warefare require faster, more
efficient, better informed ways of coordinating operations.

**Mattermost Benefit:**
* Accelerate decision advantage
* Integrate internal presonnel, contractors and mission partners
* Replace personal messaging app usage
* Increase cross-group collaboration

[Learn More »][87]
[Out of band communication team][Out of band communication team]

### Out of Band Incident Response

#### Prevent small incidents from becoming major issues

**Challenge: **Collaboration systems rely on the availability of general purpose infrastructure
which may be compromised during major breach events.

**Mattermost Benefit:**
* Separate communication for defenders and compromised assets
* Enable compliant and secure crisis communication
* Faster Mean-Time to Detect, Respond and Remediate

[Learn More »][88]

### Real-Time DevSecOps Collaboration

**Challenge: **Security and compliance requirements in critical infrastructure environments hamper
the speed and efficiency of DevSecOps workflows.

**Mattermost Benefit:**
* Ship software faster
* Streamline security and compliance
* Improve uptime and service levels
* Meet custom platform requirements
* Accelerate integration and operations in hybrid environments

[Learn More »][89]
[Man using secure chat platform][Man using secure chat platform]

### Purpose Built Collaboration

#### Accelerate mission-critical workflows across people, tools, processes and AI platforms

**Challenge: **The pace of digital transformation is growing exponentially as are the demands for
speed, resilience, security, and keeping pace with AI innovation.

**Mattermost Benefit:**
* Elevate efficiency and resilience
* Integrate operations across legacy systems, modern SaaS and advanced AI
* Accelerate decision advantage

## The Intelligent Mission Environment

Zero Trust collaboration, workflow automation, and sovereign AI — in one platform. Built for the
operational tempo of national security, cybersecurity, and critical infrastructure teams.

full audit trails.

## **Workflow & Playbook Automation **

Codify operational procedures into repeatable, automated workflows that execute consistently under
pressure.

## **Audio & Screenshare **

Sovereign real-time calls with transcription and AI-powered summarization — no external
dependencies.

## **Project & Task Management **

Kanban boards and cross-functional coordination for mission planning, sprint execution, and
compliance tracking.

## **Human-Machine Teaming **

Sovereign AI agents that enrich, triage, and brief — integrated directly into operational channels.

## **Integration & AI Platform**

Open API, webhooks, plugin architecture, and sovereign LLM connectivity — extend Mattermost into
your existing toolchain and AI infrastructure without exposing data outside your perimeter.

## **Sovereign, Integrated Language Translation **

Break language barriers across coalition and multinational operations without exposing sensitive
communications to third-party translation services.

## **Advanced Information Controls **

Attribute-Based Access Controls, classification banners, burn-on-read, data spillage mitigation, to
enforce need-to-know at every level.

[][91]

## **Microsoft Teams Interoperability **

Embed Mattermost inside Teams, Outlook, and M365 to deliver sovereign operations integrated with
global infrastructure.

## **See It All in Action **

Watch a full walkthrough of assured collaboration — secure messaging, automated playbooks, AI
agents, and sovereign deployment working together in a live mission environment.

The World’s Largest Organizations Trust NextLabs to Protect Data

"NextLabs did a great job working with us to deploy the Zero Trust Data Security to automate need to
know access policy, prevent wrongful disclosure, and protect controlled technical data. NextLabs’
team demonstrated exceptional responsiveness and expertise, helping deliver the data compliance
solution efficiently without compromising security coverage and project budget."
Dr. Udo Keller
Global Head of IT at OTTO FUCHS KG
"We were able to implement NextLabs' SAP DAM (Dynamic Authorization Management) solution in our
organization within a 4-month project. Deloitte and NextLabs did a very good job working together as
their team members were responsive and knowledgeable, preventing business disruptions while
achieving all of our goals."
Marcelo Rosenthal de Souza Gomes
IT Team Lead at Petrobras
"With NextLabs, we are able to address the GDA requirement efficiently. NextLabs brings the most
advanced data centric security solution and a dedicated team with deep industry knowledge and zero
trust expertise, we are able to deliver various programs of the DTx successfully within an
aggressive timeline."
Deepak Bhupalam
Chief Architect of DTx at Boeing

The World’s Largest Organizations Trust NextLabs to Protect Data

"NextLabs did a great job working with us to deploy the Zero Trust Data Security to automate need to
know access policy, prevent wrongful disclosure, and protect controlled technical data. NextLabs’
team demonstrated exceptional responsiveness and expertise, helping deliver the data compliance
solution efficiently without compromising security coverage and project budget."
Dr. Udo Keller
Global Head of IT at OTTO FUCHS KG
"We were able to implement NextLabs' SAP DAM (Dynamic Authorization Management) solution in our
organization within a 4-month project. Deloitte and NextLabs did a very good job working together as
their team members were responsive and knowledgeable, preventing business disruptions while
achieving all of our goals."
Marcelo Rosenthal de Souza Gomes
IT Team Lead at Petrobras
"With NextLabs, we are able to address the GDA requirement efficiently. NextLabs brings the most
advanced data centric security solution and a dedicated team with deep industry knowledge and zero
trust expertise, we are able to deliver various programs of the DTx successfully within an
aggressive timeline."
Deepak Bhupalam
Chief Architect of DTx at Boeing

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a VPN?

A Virtual Private Network (VPN) provides your business with a securely encrypted internet connection
(or “tunnel”) to securely connect devices to business assets over otherwise unsecured networks.
VPNs, like OpenVPN, work by masking your IP address and encrypting your internet traffic. VPN
protection is an important piece of a layered security protocol that’s essential to protecting
company data as well as an employee's personal data. Using a VPN service gives you the ability to
remotely access important network resources and connect your company’s branches and locations
worldwide. A [zero trust VPN][33] offers the tenets of zero trust built on the solid foundation of a
VPN.

What do VPNs do?

VPNs encrypt traffic, protect privacy, and enable secure remote access. A [remote access VPN][34]
connection secures your internet connection when you work off-site (e.g., coffee shop, hotel,
airport, or even a different country), and routes all of your sensitive network traffic through an
encrypted tunnel. Routing the network traffic disguises your IP address when using the internet,
replacing it with the location and an IP address from the VPN server making its location invisible.
A VPN connection also secures against external breaches.

What is a VPN server?

VPNs work by routing traffic through a private server. If you are using a self-managed VPN solution
like [Access Server][35], you can choose a physical server, or your VPN server can be hosted in
cloud environments. [VPN server resources][36] can help you simplify setting up your own private
server. Alternatively, you can choose a managed VPN solution, like [CloudConnexa][37], which
utilizes cloud-based servers managed by OpenVPN. In any case, the VPN will route all traffic through
a server.

What does a business VPN do?

A [business VPN][38] creates a secure connection over the internet between your devices and your
company's network. Essentially, a VPN creates a protected, encrypted tunnel through which your
sensitive data can travel, providing protection from intruders and a virtual connection to your
office network. Unlike a consumer VPN, which targets mainly personal users who are looking to
protect traffic, access the internet anonymously, or possibly access resources from other regions, a
business VPN is intended for remote and secure access to business resources on corporate private
networks with centralized control capabilities.

What VPN should I use for my business?

OpenVPN offers two secure networking solutions for small, medium, and enterprise [businesses like
yours][39].

[Access Server][40] is best for businesses that prefer an on-prem VPN server or flexibility managing
their full infrastructure through a cloud server. Choose [CloudConnexa][41] if you prefer a
cloud-delivered, managed service.

Our [product comparison][42] can help you choose the right solution for your business.

How much does a VPN cost for a small business?

OpenVPN offers solutions that can fit your budget. Whether you are looking for a [VPN for a small
business][43] or an enterprise, OpenVPN has plans starting at $7 per month per concurrent
connection, and offers a free trial to get started. Find out [how much a VPN costs for your business
size and number of connections here][44].

Can I use a VPN for free?

OpenVPN offers up to 5 free seats and a free trial for CloudConnexa, and 2 free connections for
Access Server. This makes it possible to use a [free VPN for small teams][45]. Teams will have full
functionality of OpenVPN with both the free trial and the free connections.

What is a Zero Trust VPN?

A Zero Trust VPN uses a VPN as the foundation of zero trust network access. Access Server and
CloudConnexa can be used to implement a zero trust network access solution that secures your network
resources while limiting access to only what is necessary.

What is Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)?

According to [Gartner][46], “[Zero trust network access (ZTNA)][47] is a product or service that
creates an identity- and context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of
applications.” Doing this hides the apps from discovery and restricts access using a trust broker
and a set of named entities. The broker verifies users based on identity, context, and policies —
and stops lateral movement in the network. Because application assets are removed from public
visibility, potential [attack surface][48] is reduced.

ZTNA also relies on least privilege access, which means that employees should only have access to
the programs and applications that are necessary to do their jobs. Using a VPN, you can enforce the
tenets of ZTNA and build the foundation for the principle of least privilege.

Where can I find information on OpenVPN’s pricing?

OpenVPN has transparent, flexible pricing that fits all budgets. Starting at just $7 per connection
per month, you can see a customized price based on your business size [here][49].

Does OpenVPN allow cancellation without notice?

You can cancel your subscription at any time and unused funds will be credited to your account for
future usage. For refunds, contact [sales@openvpn.net][50].

Where can I learn about OpenVPN’s compliance and security measures?

OpenVPN is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant, and performs ongoing security assessments. [Learn more about
our compliance here][51].

Where can I find OpenVPN technical support?

OpenVPN technical support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week through our [ support

functionality of OpenVPN with both the free trial and the free connections.

What is a Zero Trust VPN?

A Zero Trust VPN uses a VPN as the foundation of zero trust network access. Access Server and
CloudConnexa can be used to implement a zero trust network access solution that secures your network
resources while limiting access to only what is necessary.

What is Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)?

According to [Gartner][46], “[Zero trust network access (ZTNA)][47] is a product or service that
creates an identity- and context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of
applications.” Doing this hides the apps from discovery and restricts access using a trust broker
and a set of named entities. The broker verifies users based on identity, context, and policies —
and stops lateral movement in the network. Because application assets are removed from public
visibility, potential [attack surface][48] is reduced.

ZTNA also relies on least privilege access, which means that employees should only have access to
the programs and applications that are necessary to do their jobs. Using a VPN, you can enforce the
tenets of ZTNA and build the foundation for the principle of least privilege.

Where can I find information on OpenVPN’s pricing?

OpenVPN has transparent, flexible pricing that fits all budgets. Starting at just $7 per connection
per month, you can see a customized price based on your business size [here][49].

Does OpenVPN allow cancellation without notice?

You can cancel your subscription at any time and unused funds will be credited to your account for
future usage. For refunds, contact [sales@openvpn.net][50].

Where can I learn about OpenVPN’s compliance and security measures?

OpenVPN is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant, and performs ongoing security assessments. [Learn more about
our compliance here][51].

Where can I find OpenVPN technical support?

OpenVPN technical support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week through our [ support
portal][52].

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

### Tips to Improve Network Stability

**1**

#### Use Wired Connections for Network Reliability

Whenever possible, opt for a wired ethernet connection. While Wi-Fi is convenient, it can introduce
latency and instability on your network, especially if you are far away from your router. Also, if
there are multiple Wi-Fi networks in your area, they can interfere with your own network potentially
causing packet loss. Additionally, various Bluetooth devices can sometimes share the same operating
frequency as your wireless network. This can cause major problems if both your Bluetooth device and
your Wi-Fi network card are located near each other. Switching to ethernet will eliminate these
issues while providing a stable link directly to your network which can drastically improve your
network stability.

**2**

#### Monitor Lag Spikes While Gaming

While playing video games, you may experience lag spikes or dropped packets. To help find the issue,
run this test on a second monitor or in the background while playing. If you notice a correlation
between lag spikes on the monitoring tool and when you experience lag in the game, then the culprit
is likely your own network. If not, then the issue is likely with the game’s server. You can also
enable sound notifications when a certain latency threshold is hit. Enabling this feature will cause
a soft bell sound to play every time there is a ping over the set amount. This means you can focus
on the game and not stare at the ping monitoring tool.

**3**

#### Continually Monitor your Networks Performance

This tool has the ability to run for an unlimited amount of time. That means you should be using
this tool whenever you think there is a chance you will experience issues. The more often you are
monitoring your network the higher the chance of you noticing a pattern of when you experience
instability. The more information you gather the quicker you can determine the root cause. Also, try
running the stability test while on both your home and wireless cell networks. If using a laptop or
desktop, set up a mobile hotspot on your phone and connect to that. You may also try switching
between any of the available servers around the world and see if you notice similar results.

**4**

#### Optimize Your Router Settings for Better Performance

Delving into your router's settings can significantly improve your network stability. Start by
accessing your router's admin panel through a web browser, usually by entering its IP address. Once
there, ensure you're using the latest firmware, as updates often include performance improvements
and security patches. Next, experiment with changing your Wi-Fi channel. In crowded areas, many
networks might be using the same channel, causing interference. Use a Wi-Fi analyzer app to find
less congested channels. For dual-band routers, try separating your devices between the 2.4GHz and
5GHz bands. The 2.4GHz band offers better range but is more prone to interference, while the 5GHz
band provides faster speeds over shorter distances. Consider enabling Quality of Service (QoS)
settings if available. This feature allows you to prioritize certain types of traffic or specific
devices, ensuring that critical applications like video calls or online gaming get preference.
Finally, if you're not using certain features like WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) or UPnP (Universal
Plug and Play), consider disabling them as they can sometimes be exploited by attackers and may
impact performance.

and security patches. Next, experiment with changing your Wi-Fi channel. In crowded areas, many
networks might be using the same channel, causing interference. Use a Wi-Fi analyzer app to find
less congested channels. For dual-band routers, try separating your devices between the 2.4GHz and
5GHz bands. The 2.4GHz band offers better range but is more prone to interference, while the 5GHz
band provides faster speeds over shorter distances. Consider enabling Quality of Service (QoS)
settings if available. This feature allows you to prioritize certain types of traffic or specific
devices, ensuring that critical applications like video calls or online gaming get preference.
Finally, if you're not using certain features like WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) or UPnP (Universal
Plug and Play), consider disabling them as they can sometimes be exploited by attackers and may
impact performance.

**5**

#### Check for Hardware or ISP Issues

If you determine the issue to be on your end, it could be an issue with your modem or your Internet
service provider. Always try resetting your router and or modem before anything else. In some cases,
you may have access to the ONT box which sits between your modem and the outside network. Lookup a
guide on how to reset your specific model from the ISP if you can access it. In conjunction with the
previous tips, try running the stability test on various hardware. If you have an extra router or
modem available to you, swap out one component at a time until you find the culprit. Even ethernet
cables can be faulty, so swap out a cable, run the test again and then repeat. If all else fails,
most ISPs provide online reset tools to which provide similar functionally to physically resetting
your connection.

**6**

#### Implement Network Segmentation for Enhanced Security and Stability

Network segmentation is a powerful technique that can improve both the security and stability of
your network. This process involves dividing your network into smaller, separate subnetworks. Start
by creating a guest network for visitors, which keeps their traffic separate from your main network
and prevents potential security risks. If you have smart home devices, consider placing them on
their own VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network). This not only isolates potentially vulnerable IoT
devices from your main network but also prevents their often chatty nature from clogging up your
primary network traffic. For those working from home, create a separate network segment for
work-related devices and traffic. This can help maintain a stable connection for important work
tasks and video calls, unaffected by other household internet usage. Advanced users might even
consider implementing VLANs for different types of traffic or device categories. While setting up
network segmentation might require some technical know-how, many modern routers offer easy-to-use
features for basic segmentation. By properly segmenting your network, you can significantly enhance
both its stability and security.

**7**

#### Leverage DNS and Caching Techniques to Boost Network Performance

Optimizing your Domain Name System (DNS) settings and implementing effective caching strategies can
lead to noticeable improvements in your network's performance and stability. Start by changing your
DNS server from your ISP's default to a faster, more reliable option like Google's Public DNS
(8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4) or Cloudflare's DNS (1.1.1.1). These services often provide faster response
times and can improve your browsing speed. Next, consider setting up a local DNS cache server on
your network. This can dramatically reduce DNS lookup times for frequently visited websites. For
more advanced users, implementing a Pi-hole on your network not only provides network-wide ad
blocking but also acts as a DNS cache, potentially improving overall network performance. On the
client side, regularly clear your device's DNS cache to ensure you're not holding onto outdated DNS
information. For Windows users, this can be done by running the command "ipconfig /flushdns" in the
Command Prompt. Mac users can use the Terminal command "sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder".
Additionally, consider adjusting the Time-to-Live (TTL) settings in your router if available. A
longer TTL for DNS entries can reduce the frequency of DNS lookups, potentially improving
performance, especially for frequently visited sites. By optimizing your DNS settings and
implementing effective caching strategies, you can reduce latency and improve the overall
responsiveness of your network.

cables can be faulty, so swap out a cable, run the test again and then repeat. If all else fails,
most ISPs provide online reset tools to which provide similar functionally to physically resetting
your connection.

**6**

#### Implement Network Segmentation for Enhanced Security and Stability

Network segmentation is a powerful technique that can improve both the security and stability of
your network. This process involves dividing your network into smaller, separate subnetworks. Start
by creating a guest network for visitors, which keeps their traffic separate from your main network
and prevents potential security risks. If you have smart home devices, consider placing them on
their own VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network). This not only isolates potentially vulnerable IoT
devices from your main network but also prevents their often chatty nature from clogging up your
primary network traffic. For those working from home, create a separate network segment for
work-related devices and traffic. This can help maintain a stable connection for important work
tasks and video calls, unaffected by other household internet usage. Advanced users might even
consider implementing VLANs for different types of traffic or device categories. While setting up
network segmentation might require some technical know-how, many modern routers offer easy-to-use
features for basic segmentation. By properly segmenting your network, you can significantly enhance
both its stability and security.

**7**

#### Leverage DNS and Caching Techniques to Boost Network Performance

Optimizing your Domain Name System (DNS) settings and implementing effective caching strategies can
lead to noticeable improvements in your network's performance and stability. Start by changing your
DNS server from your ISP's default to a faster, more reliable option like Google's Public DNS
(8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4) or Cloudflare's DNS (1.1.1.1). These services often provide faster response
times and can improve your browsing speed. Next, consider setting up a local DNS cache server on
your network. This can dramatically reduce DNS lookup times for frequently visited websites. For
more advanced users, implementing a Pi-hole on your network not only provides network-wide ad
blocking but also acts as a DNS cache, potentially improving overall network performance. On the
client side, regularly clear your device's DNS cache to ensure you're not holding onto outdated DNS
information. For Windows users, this can be done by running the command "ipconfig /flushdns" in the
Command Prompt. Mac users can use the Terminal command "sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder".
Additionally, consider adjusting the Time-to-Live (TTL) settings in your router if available. A
longer TTL for DNS entries can reduce the frequency of DNS lookups, potentially improving
performance, especially for frequently visited sites. By optimizing your DNS settings and
implementing effective caching strategies, you can reduce latency and improve the overall
responsiveness of your network.

central hub for staying informed about the latest news, events, products, equipment, technology and
services in the print industry. 

We strive to keep our members up to date with the latest trends and advancements, helping them stay
competitive in the ever-evolving printing landscape.

SD-WAN, split-tunneling, аппаратные MFA-токены, защищённые логи сессий.

SOC-мониторинг 24/7. Threat Hunting, SIEM-интеграция, реагирование с SLA 15 минут.

защиты коммерческой тайны и независимости от третьих сторон

## Secure, high-performance compute platforms for AI, research, and mission-critical workloads.
## No hyperscalers. No foreign control planes. No assumptions. Every layer is verified.

[Request a Briefing][27][View Capabilities][28]

## **What is Qvelo?**

### We Define and Validate High-Performance, Sovereign Compute Infrastructure.


Qvelo is a Canadian technology and infrastructure firm specializing in high-performance computing,
artificial intelligence, and data-intensive systems. We define, validate, and guide the
implementation of secure, scalable, and inspectable compute environments that enable organizations
to run advanced workloads with full control over performance, data, and governance.

Our role is to ensure systems are correct before irreversible decisions are made, and remain under
your control once deployed.

Sovereignty claims are easy to make. Verifying them requires system-level analysis.

## **Why Choose Us?**

Built for Performance. Engineered for Sovereignty. Trusted for Execution.

#### Expertise

Our team brings decades of experience across HPC, AI infrastructure, large-scale storage, and
high-performance networking.
We deliver systems that perform in real-world environments, not just theoretical designs.

#### Security

Qvelo is built for environments where security is non-negotiable.
Our team includes professionals with experience in national security, telecommunications, and
critical infrastructure. We design systems aligned to Canadian data sovereignty, privacy, and
government-grade security requirements.

#### Secure Test Facility

Our Test and Development Centre enables benchmarking, validation, and optimization of AI and HPC
workloads in a controlled, sovereignty-aligned environment.
Clients can validate performance, scalability, and architecture decisions before deployment.

#### Customized Solutions

Every environment is different.
We design infrastructure aligned to your operational, regulatory, and performance requirements,
ensuring solutions are fit-for-purpose and future-ready.

#### Before You Commit to Infrastructure

Most organizations commit to architecture decisions before fully understanding their long-term
implications.
Qvelo ensures those decisions are correct before capital is deployed and systems are locked in.

## The Sovereign Test

### If You Cannot Answer Yes to These, It Is Not Sovereign

Sovereignty is not a marketing term. It is an architectural and operational reality. This is not a
checklist. It is a pass/fail test.  Most systems fail this test.

The cost of getting it wrong is measured in lost control, degraded performance, and irreversible
architectural lock-in.

Qvelo applies a clear, testable framework to every platform:
* Are data storage, provenance, and compliance Canadian?
* Are compute infrastructure, networking, and the software stack Canadian-controlled?
* Are training processes, documentation, and auditability Canadian?
* Are alignment frameworks and governance structures Canadian?
* Are jurisdiction and accountability Canadian, with no exposure to foreign legal compulsion?
* Is ownership Canadian, with no external veto control?
* Does the infrastructure physically reside in Canada?

If any answer is no, the system is not sovereign — regardless of vendor claims.

ensuring solutions are fit-for-purpose and future-ready.

#### Before You Commit to Infrastructure

Most organizations commit to architecture decisions before fully understanding their long-term
implications.
Qvelo ensures those decisions are correct before capital is deployed and systems are locked in.

## The Sovereign Test

### If You Cannot Answer Yes to These, It Is Not Sovereign

Sovereignty is not a marketing term. It is an architectural and operational reality. This is not a
checklist. It is a pass/fail test.  Most systems fail this test.

The cost of getting it wrong is measured in lost control, degraded performance, and irreversible
architectural lock-in.

Qvelo applies a clear, testable framework to every platform:
* Are data storage, provenance, and compliance Canadian?
* Are compute infrastructure, networking, and the software stack Canadian-controlled?
* Are training processes, documentation, and auditability Canadian?
* Are alignment frameworks and governance structures Canadian?
* Are jurisdiction and accountability Canadian, with no exposure to foreign legal compulsion?
* Is ownership Canadian, with no external veto control?
* Does the infrastructure physically reside in Canada?

If any answer is no, the system is not sovereign — regardless of vendor claims.

[Learn More About Sovereignty][29]

## Our Services

Architecture, Validation, and Performance for AI and HPC Infrastructure

#### Architecture & Validation
* * Infrastructure architecture and system design
  * Performance and scaling validation
  * Sovereignty gap analysis and risk identification

#### Infrastructure Strategy & Deployment Guidance
* * AI and HPC platform strategy
  * Vendor and architecture selection
  * Sovereign and hybrid deployment models

#### Performance & Optimization
* * Workload tuning and performance engineering
  * Benchmarking and scaling analysis
  * System optimization under real-world conditions

#### Executive & Technical Enablement
* * Executive briefings and technical workshops
  * Hands-on training for HPC and AI environments
  * Operational and engineering guidance

## Experience Across Government, Research, and Enterprise

Qvelo has supported advanced compute, AI, and data infrastructure initiatives across a range of
secure and high-performance environments.
Our experience includes federal and national digital infrastructure organizations supporting
mission-critical workloads, leading Canadian universities and research institutions enabling
large-scale scientific computing, regulated industries and advanced manufacturing environments, and
global infrastructure and technology providers.
Due to the nature of many of these engagements, specific client details are not publicly disclosed.
Additional information is available upon request under appropriate confidentiality conditions.

## Join Us in Building Canada’s Sovereign Digital Future

Whether you are designing AI infrastructure, modernizing HPC environments, or building secure,
data-sovereign platforms, Qvelo ensures the architecture is correct before critical decisions are
made.

[Careers][131] * [Contact Us][132] * [Request a Demo][133] # **Agentic identities** are sprawling at unprecedented rates
Radiant Logic has unified fragmented, ungovernable identity data for over 20 years. That same identity data platform now extends to the AI-enabled enterprise, unifying human, non-human, and agentic identities into one authoritative source of truth. ### RadiantOne ## The Data Foundation for Your IAM Program Every downstream tool, policy, and AI access decision depends on context. We make sure that context is accurate, complete, and trusted. Unify Observe Act Powered by AIDA Artificial Intelligence Data Assistant ### Unify * Aggregate, correlate, cleanse, and synchronize human, non-human, and agentic identity data from hundreds of sources into a single authoritative cloud * Power every downstream IAM tool, AI model, and automated workflow to operate with full context * Eliminate the blind spots that leave your security stack exposed and enforce smarter, context-aware policies ### Observe * Continuously monitor access paths, entitlements, and identity changes across across every identity: human, non-human, and agents * Automatically detect orphaned, dormant access, policy drift, and emerging risks * Maintain a complete, always-current picture of who or what has access to what and whether it’s justified ### Act * Move from insight to action with AI-assisted, human-in-loop workflows across humans, non-humans, and agents * Remediate, validate, and orchestrate responses across your IAM and security stack * Leverage Shared Signals Framework (SSF) to coordinate access revocation, kill-switch scenarios, and closed-loop response with PAM, SIEM, XDR, and Zero Trust Controls ### Powered by AIDA Artificial Intelligence Data Assistant * Reveal identity relationships across users, accounts, roles, permissions, agents, and systems * Pinpoint anomalies, excessive privilege, and risky behavior across every identity class * Recommend and guide remediation with explainable, auditable outcomes [Explore Platform][134] ## What Our Customers are Saying [ [A man in a suit and glasses sits in an office, discussing identity data. On-screen text reads: Rajnish Bhatia, Vice President, Cyber Security, Comcast. # Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

## Preemptive exposure management with RedSeal

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

## Protecting the world.

No more chasing checks or waiting for checks to get cut. RunBuggy makes it easy to pay for shipping
and for transporters to get paid fast.

Track your car delivery just like you track a package. Know where and when your car will arrive from
any device.

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response

## AI changed everything.
## The threat landscape included.

Attackers now use AI to generate code, move at machine speed, and exploit gaps. The old model was
built for a slower era. That era is over.

[Floating translucent dashboard cards on a purple-violet gradient, showing 45%, 465, “Purple AI
Summary…”, and a white bar chart]
0202

## The AI era demands a new advantage. SentinelOne delivers it.

One platform powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence. Built to stop emerging threats at machine
speed and give defenders the upper hand.

The AI-Native Cybersecurity Platform

## Built for Defenders.
## Engineered for Advantage.

Endpoint & Identity SecuritySecuring AICloud SecurityAutonomous SOCGlobal Services

### Protect Every Device. Secure Every Identity.

Autonomously stop supply chain, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse with AI-native
endpoint and identity protection unified in a single lightweight agent.
* Stop threats at machine speed with behavioral AI
* Detect and disrupt identity-based attacks in real time
* Real-time, AI-automated response and remediation
* Deploy in SaaS, on-premises, hybrid, and air-gapped environments

[See Industry Recognition][79]

for Endpoint Protection Platforms.

[Explore the Singularity Platform][83]

sidebar “Wayfinder”]

### Protection That Moves at Machine Speed

Detect, contain, and respond to threats in real time with AI-native protection. AI that does more
than protect your business. It protects the AI your business relies on.

Human Amplification

### Less Noise. More Impact from Every Analyst

Purple AI and agentic workflows handle triage, correlation, and routine response so analysts can
focus on higher-value decisions.

Intuitive by Design

### Faster Decisions. Simpler Operations.

A unified experience that brings visibility, investigation, and action together in a single console
so your team can move faster with less friction.

runners across multi-cloud environments, to SaaS tools and infrastructure, Tailscale connects it
all, seamlessly.

ITSecurityDevOpsEngineering
[An illustration showing how IT might use Tailscale]

### Installation takes minutes

Get started in minutes. Integrations apply policies to your teams at scale.

### Switching is easy

Cross-platform and infrastructure agnostic to give the flexibility you need.

### Bridge hybrid environments

Across clouds or on-prem, Tailscale’s mesh overlay network connects it all.

## Developer approved,
## But don’t just take our word for it.

@sharathpataliSharath Patali

Setting up a mesh VPN on all my devices was so damn easy thanks to @Tailscale. A tightly sealed
network of remote devices with almost no configuration and also ease of adding a new device to the
mesh is just what I wanted. Amazing work @Tailscale!

@LiamJKeeganLiam Keegan

Uhh this is sweet! Redirecting SSL authentication to Tailscale to handle it for you eliminates the
need to manage PKI at scale, or go through the nightmare of changing keys out when someone leaves.
And, EVERYTHING is protected, regardless of where the workload lives. AWESOME!

MP
@moderat10nMichael P.

After installing @Tailscale on a bunch of machines on my home network (Linux x86 + aarch64, MacOS,
Windows) I've just ventured out. Had to restart the process but holy moly, just SSH'ed into my
boxes, building code and pushing configs around like I'm home. Amazing. Converted

TL
@tessalauTessa Lau

Just paid for @Tailscale. Installed it on our robots; so far so good. Compared to OpenVPN: *
Serverless * Always on * Same config in office & field * Scales to large # devices * GUI-based ACL
w/SSO * Fixed IPs, DNS-friendly * Dead simple config+use

@morgallantMorgan Gallant

The beauty of @Tailscale is that they enable people to make their own personal internet, for free in
most cases. It’s this weird paradigm shift, since you have to actively work to make applications
insecure rather than the other way around.

@johnrlynchJohn Lynch

If you deal with servers in any way drop everything and get this. VPN nirvana. @Tailscale
https://tailscale.com

@devilmonasteryMichael R.

@Tailscale busts double nat (travel router -> plane wifi) and connects me to my home server so I can
silence a prometheus humidity alert (can’t really add water to the humidifier from here).

@oddurOddur Magnusson

Sometimes you come across a tool that changes how you see things, @Tailscale is one of those.
Thinking in terms of point 2 point VPN tunnels seems so outdated once you have seen that lights.

@jgavinrayJ. Gavin Ray

Been using @Tailscale for a while at work and personally. Who would have thought networking could
be... easy?!

@dixdotdevbig jim

The campus WiFi also prevented my original Wireguard VPN. Multiple NATs, blocked ports... Tailscale
just figures it all out. There's honestly dozens of other reasons, but for me it just helps me to be
portable. I run pihole too. I'd be lost without it now!

Oh @Tailscale, I’ve put you off for so long not knowing what I was missing. In advance of #KubeCon I

Thanks to @Tailscale being available as a package for @Synology I was able to renew @letsencrypt

# Tcpreplay[¶][63]

**Tcpreplay is a suite of GPLv3 utilities for editing and replaying network traffic that was
previously captured** by tools like `tcpdump` and Wireshark. Take a `.pcap` file, optionally rewrite
its Layer 2–4 headers, and push it back onto the wire — at the original timing, a fixed rate, or as
fast as the hardware allows.

It is used by firewall, IDS/IPS, NetFlow and other networking vendors, enterprises, universities,
and open-source projects to test and tune devices against realistic, repeatable traffic.
* **New here?**
  
  Install the suite and replay your first capture in five minutes.
  
  [ Quickstart][64]
* **The tools**
  
  Six focused command-line tools. Learn what each is for and how to drive it.
  
  [ Tools overview][65]
* **How-to guides**
  
  Task-oriented recipes: line-rate testing, header rewriting, live TCP replay.
  
  [ Guides][66]
* **Concepts**
  
  The mental model behind the suite: the replay pipeline, timing, DLT plugins.
  
  [ Concepts][67]

## What can you do with it?[¶][68]
* **Replay traffic**
  
  Send a capture back onto the network with `tcpreplay` — preserving the original inter-packet
  timing, or at a target rate in packets/sec or Mbps, or flat-out at line rate.
* **Rewrite packets**
  
  Rewrite MAC/IP addresses, ports, VLAN tags, checksums and more with `tcprewrite`, without touching
  the payload semantics — ideal for retargeting a capture at your lab.
* **Split client/server**
  
  Classify each packet as client- or server-side with `tcpprep`, so a single capture can drive a
  two-NIC in-line test through a device under test.
* **Replay to a live server**
  
  Replay a captured TCP session against a real server with `tcpliveplay`, exercising the full stack
  up to the application — not just Layer 2.

## The suite at a glance[¶][69]

─────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Tool                 │One-liner                                                                  
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpreplay`][70]    │Replay pcap files onto the network at arbitrary speeds.                    
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpreplay-edit`][71│Replay while rewriting headers in one pass (`tcpreplay` + `tcprewrite`).   
]                    │                                                                           
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcprewrite`][72]   │Rewrite Layer 2–4 headers in a pcap (front end to `libtcpedit`).           
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpprep`][73]      │Pre-process a pcap into a cache file, classifying packets as client/server.
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpbridge`][74]    │Bridge two network segments, applying `tcprewrite` logic in flight.        
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────

**Tcpreplay is a suite of GPLv3 utilities for editing and replaying network traffic that was
previously captured** by tools like `tcpdump` and Wireshark. Take a `.pcap` file, optionally rewrite
its Layer 2–4 headers, and push it back onto the wire — at the original timing, a fixed rate, or as

It is used by firewall, IDS/IPS, NetFlow and other networking vendors, enterprises, universities,
and open-source projects to test and tune devices against realistic, repeatable traffic.
* **New here?**

* **The tools**

## What can you do with it?[¶][68]
* **Replay traffic**
  
  Send a capture back onto the network with `tcpreplay` — preserving the original inter-packet
  timing, or at a target rate in packets/sec or Mbps, or flat-out at line rate.
* **Rewrite packets**
  
  Rewrite MAC/IP addresses, ports, VLAN tags, checksums and more with `tcprewrite`, without touching
  the payload semantics — ideal for retargeting a capture at your lab.
* **Split client/server**

* **Replay to a live server**
  
  Replay a captured TCP session against a real server with `tcpliveplay`, exercising the full stack
  up to the application — not just Layer 2.

## The suite at a glance[¶][69]

─────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Tool                 │One-liner                                                                  
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpreplay`][70]    │Replay pcap files onto the network at arbitrary speeds.                    
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpreplay-edit`][71│Replay while rewriting headers in one pass (`tcpreplay` + `tcprewrite`).   
]                    │                                                                           
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcprewrite`][72]   │Rewrite Layer 2–4 headers in a pcap (front end to `libtcpedit`).           
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpprep`][73]      │Pre-process a pcap into a cache file, classifying packets as client/server.
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpbridge`][74]    │Bridge two network segments, applying `tcprewrite` logic in flight.        
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpliveplay`][75]  │Replay a captured TCP session against a live server (full stack).          
─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[`tcpcapinfo`][76]   │Inspect and debug the raw structure of a pcap file.                        
─────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

`tcpreplay` vs `tcpreplay-edit`

When built with editing support, you also get **`tcpreplay-edit`**, which is `tcpreplay` with all of
`tcprewrite`'s rewriting options folded in — so you can rewrite headers *and* replay in a single
pass. Plain `tcpreplay` is the lean, edit-free replay engine.

## Why it exists[¶][77]

Real network traffic is messy, bursty, and hard to reproduce on demand. Tcpreplay lets you capture a
slice of it once and replay it deterministically as often as you like — the same packets, the same
timing, at whatever speed your test calls for. That makes it possible to benchmark throughput,
reproduce a bug, regression-test a firewall rule, or drive a NetFlow appliance to its limits, all
from a saved `.pcap`.
